# Api

* [Common problem model (RFC 9457 errors)](common-problem-model.md) - Every API error is an application/problem+json body with a closed code enum and per-field errors, as defined by common-problem-v1.yaml and written by one component.
* [Identity API (v1)](identity-api.md) - The identity module's HTTP operations, signUp, logIn, logOut and getSession under /api/v1/auth, defined in identity-api-v1.yaml.
* [To-do API (v1)](todo-api.md) - The to-dos module's HTTP operations under /api/v1/todos, covering list, create, get, update, done toggle, delete and clear-completed, defined in todo-api-v1.yaml.
